name: Souju
source:
A boy of the Purple.
Born through mating, he is destined to become the next leader of the Purple.
He was raised in isolation on a remote island, but came to Tenguu Island to enroll in Jintoku Academy.
He looks up to his guardian, [url=/c156332]Shizuku[/url], as if she were his mother.
